trackInfo.heading: Opening Times
trackInfo.text:
Centre opening hours:

Monday – Friday: 7:00 am – 10:00 pm
Saturday – Sunday: 8:00 am – 6:00 pm
Bank Holidays: 10:00 am – 6:00 pm

Track session times are published separately by the operator. Hours can change for events and bank holidays, so check with the venue before travelling.

trackInfo.heading: Entry Price
trackInfo.text: Track prices and bookings are listed on the operator's athletics page.

trackInfo.heading: Track Details
trackInfo.text:
Length: 400m outdoor oval, plus indoor athletics facilities that are available all year.
Field Facilities: Jump pits, throwing cages, pole vault and javelin equipment.

trackInfo.heading: Parking Details
trackInfo.text: Four accessible parking bays are available at the centre.

trackInfo.heading: Address
trackInfo.text: David Weir Leisure Centre, Middleton Road, Carshalton, SM5 1SL

trackInfo.heading: Website
trackInfo.text: Visit the Everyone Active website for athletics times, prices and bookings.
